# tag: geo.multiple-capitals
which countries have more than one capital | countries with two capitals | countries with three capitals => South Africa has three capitals. Bolivia, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Benin, Ivory Coast, Sri Lanka and Tanzania each split capital jobs between two cities in some way.
why does south africa have three capitals | pretoria cape town bloemfontein => South Africa has three capitals so power is shared: Pretoria for the government, Cape Town for parliament and Bloemfontein for the top courts. It was a compromise when the country formed in 1910.
is the hague the capital of the netherlands | amsterdam or the hague capital | where is the dutch government => Amsterdam is the capital of the Netherlands, but the government and parliament are in The Hague.
what is putrajaya | kuala lumpur or putrajaya capital => Kuala Lumpur is the capital of Malaysia, but most government offices moved to the planned city of Putrajaya, starting in 1999.
is colombo the capital of sri lanka | colombo or kotte capital => Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is Sri Lanka's official capital, where the parliament is. Colombo, right next to it, is the biggest city and business center.
does eswatini have two capitals | mbabane or lobamba capital => Mbabane is Eswatini's government capital, while Lobamba is the royal and parliament capital.
# tag: geo.group
what countries are in scandinavia | which countries are scandinavian => Scandinavia is Denmark, Norway and Sweden. Many people also include Finland and Iceland, but those five together are more correctly called the Nordic countries.
what are the nordic countries | nordic countries list => The Nordic countries are Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland, plus territories like Greenland, the Faroe Islands and Åland.
what are the benelux countries | what is benelux => Benelux is Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg. The name joins the start of each country's name.
what are the baltic states | which countries are the baltics => The Baltic states are Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, on the east coast of the Baltic Sea. They became independent again in 1991.
what countries are in the balkans | where are the balkans => The Balkans usually include Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Greece, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and part of Turkey, and sometimes Romania and Slovenia.
what are the caucasus countries | where is the caucasus region => The South Caucasus countries are Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan. The northern side of the Caucasus Mountains is part of Russia.
what are the stans | list of stan countries => Seven countries end in -stan: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Afghanistan and Pakistan.
what countries are in central asia | central asian countries => Central Asia is usually Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan.
what countries are in the horn of africa | what is the horn of africa => The Horn of Africa is the pointy part of East Africa that sticks out into the Arabian Sea. It includes Somalia, Ethiopia, Eritrea and Djibouti.
what countries are in the maghreb | what is the maghreb => The Maghreb is northwest Africa: Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya and Mauritania. Maghreb means the west in Arabic.
what countries are in the middle east | what is the middle east => The Middle East usually includes Egypt, Turkey, Iran, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, the Palestinian territories, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Oman, the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and Cyprus.
what countries are in southeast asia | southeast asian countries => Southeast Asia has 11 countries: Brunei, Cambodia, East Timor, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
what countries are in central america | central american countries => Central America has seven countries: Belize, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama.
what countries are in the caribbean | caribbean island nations => The Caribbean has 13 independent island countries, including Cuba, Jamaica, Haiti, the Dominican Republic, the Bahamas, Barbados, and Trinidad and Tobago, plus many territories of other countries.
what countries are on the iberian peninsula | what is iberia => The Iberian Peninsula holds Spain, Portugal and Andorra, plus Gibraltar, a British territory.
what are the british isles | what countries are in the british isles => The British Isles are the islands of Great Britain, Ireland and many smaller ones. They hold the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands.
what is latin america | which countries are in latin america => Latin America is the countries in the Americas where Spanish, Portuguese or French is mainly spoken, like Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Cuba.
what are the low countries | why are they called the low countries => The Low Countries are Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, named because so much of the land is low and flat.
what is melanesia | what is polynesia => The Pacific islands are grouped into Melanesia (like Fiji and Papua New Guinea), Micronesia (like Palau and Guam) and Polynesia (like Hawaii, Samoa, Tonga and New Zealand).
what is the polynesian triangle | what places are in polynesia => Polynesia is a giant triangle of islands with Hawaii, New Zealand and Easter Island at its corners.
what is sub saharan africa | what does sub saharan mean => Sub-Saharan Africa is all the countries of Africa south of the Sahara Desert.
what is the levant | which countries are in the levant => The Levant is the eastern Mediterranean coast: Lebanon, Syria, Israel, the Palestinian territories and Jordan, and sometimes Cyprus.
what is oceania | what countries are in oceania => Oceania is Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea and the Pacific island countries. It has 14 countries.

what is the commonwealth | how many countries are in the commonwealth => As of 2025, the Commonwealth of Nations is a group of 56 countries, most of which used to be part of the British Empire.
